plaintext_prediction_model.origin: new standalone plaintext predictor with optional conservative structural support features and public zero-master residual logits

reference_basis.access: read-only backup review; no runtime import or wholesale code copy
reference_basis.algorithm: SIMON64 state recurrence x_next = y XOR (ROL1(x) AND ROL8(x)) XOR ROL2(x); zero-master-key first four round keys are zero; absolute residual logit = (1-2g)*z

support_features.algorithm: backward set propagation through the public plaintext recurrence, unioning dependencies of XOR and AND inputs; conservative overapproximation because algebraic cancellations are not removed; no labels, key, or data access
support_features.bit_order: 64-bit MSB-first; x positions 0..31 and y positions 32..63

plaintext_prediction_model.implementation: src/cipher_experiments/models/prediction.py; independent Torch bitwise/Boolean-float recurrence and predictor subclassing BitMLP
plaintext_prediction_model.validation_oracle: synthetic unit tests compare public rounds 1..4 with this repository's scalar SIMON64/128 encryption at zero key and exercise support invariance using synthetic random keys
plaintext_prediction_model.dependencies: torch and the local BitMLP only; no cipher/data/config/training/key dependency in production model module
